title: Searching in the Reassign lead technician dialog narrows the technician list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Three eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] "Esther Howard", [Tech-B] "Ralph Edwards", [Tech-C] "Dana Ortiz". A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • No other eligible technician at this location has "ral" anywhere in its name (any case), and none matches "zzqx".
  • One staff member who must NOT be offered: an Office-role user "Owen Office".
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A].
  • The staff names are used in the expected results (and typed in the steps) and stay as written; the number is an example. The expected results quote the design as "S1-702 · ZZ Board Test Co": on this run that is [WO-1] · ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] = "Ralph Edwards" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-C] = "Dana Ortiz" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it).
  4. One staff member who must NOT be offered: an Office-role user ("Owen Office"). Create them the same way under Settings > Staff, but pick the Office role.
  5. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  6. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-702"): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
  7. Check the setup worked: Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" on Work Orders > All shows [WO-1] with Lead Technician [Tech-A]; Settings > Staff shows no other active technician at this location whose name contains "ral" (e.g. "Fitzgerald" does). If one does, switch off Time Clock on that staff record for this case (and turn it back on afterwards). Then clear the search.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" in Search.
  3. Hover [WO-1]'s card in [Tech-A]'s column and click its More actions (…) button.
  4. Choose Reassign lead technician.
  5. Read the top of the dialog and the list of choices.
  6. Click the dialog's search box (it reads "Search technicians") and type Ral
  7. Clear the search box and type ral (all lower case).
  8. Clear the search box and type Owen
  9. Clear the search box and type zzqx
  10. Clear the search box.
  11. Click Cancel.
  12. Open the same card's More actions menu again and choose Reassign lead technician.
  13. Read the search box.
  14. Click Cancel.
  15. Pick Tech View in the display switcher and repeat steps 3 to 14 using the row's More actions (…) button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the dialog names the work order it is changing, by number and customer (in the design: "S1-702 · ZZ Board Test Co"), and marks Esther Howard as the current lead (the design highlights her with a check mark). Write down what you see; a different layout alone is not a fail.
  • Step 5: the list offers Unassigned and the eligible technicians of this location, e.g. Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz.
  • Step 6: only technicians whose name contains "Ral" stay in the list: Ralph Edwards. Esther Howard and Dana Ortiz disappear from it.
  • Step 7: lower-case "ral" gives the same list, Ralph Edwards only. Upper or lower case does not matter.
  • Step 8: no technician is listed for "Owen". Owen Office has the Office role and is never offered, not even by searching.
  • Steps 8 and 9: when nothing matches, the dialog says so and repeats what you typed (in the design: No technicians match “zzqx”). Write down the words you see; a different wording alone is not a fail.
  • Step 10: clearing the search box brings back the whole list from step 5.
  • Step 11: nothing changes. The card stays in Esther Howard's column and no message appears.
  • Step 13: the search box is empty when the dialog opens again.
  • Step 15: Tech View behaves the same way, and the row stays in Esther Howard's group.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R12, S4-R14 and section 8 "Design updates required from Branko" (Reassign dialog content and search), read 8 Oct 2026. Eligibility from PRD section 5 Terminology (Technician). Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Branko Cicovic, Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): Reassign dialog subtitle "work order number · customer" (assignSub, line 1363), search box "Search technicians" (line 357) keeping the technicians whose name contains the typed text in any letter case (lines 1180-1181), current lead highlighted with a check mark, no-match text "No technicians match “the typed text”" (line 1366), search emptied each time the dialog opens (openAssign, line 900). Design crawl 8 Oct 2026: Board View state 225 and Tech View state 193 ("S1-702 · Fibridge Commercial"), Board View states 227-228 ("No technicians match “Fib”", "No technicians match “zzqx-no-match”"). Design-only details (subtitle, search behaviour, no-match text, current-lead mark) are cited to the design; the PRD does not fix their wording. The list content (eligible technicians and Unassigned) follows S4-R12. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R12: “The dialog offers eligible active technicians in the current location and Unassigned.”
  • S4-R14: “Canceling the dialog leaves the lead unchanged.”
  • Design updates required from Branko: “Reassign dialog content, search, grouping, avatars, and exact “N open” count.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
